children: It can be much more fun to shop for kids, because of how gleeful a child can get over a souped-up toy car or a new "it" doll. So if you're stumped by what to get someone this year, consider something that will bring back the joy of being a kid. Grown-up jewelry, clothing and accessories with a nod to youthful exuberance are sure to make them giddy.
